fact: The BCEAO launched PI-SPI on 30 September 2025 for the eight UEMOA countries, with over 80 institutions engaged and 45 ready to start; Burkina Faso institutions followed the launch.
leFaso.net reports that the BCEAO's PI-SPI instant payment platform, launched 30 September 2025, serves the UEMOA, with 80 institutions connected by 24 June 2026.
Nine institutions in Burkina Faso are authorised to offer services on the BCEAO's WAEMU-wide PI-SPI instant payment platform, as of 24 February 2026.
L'Oeil du Sahel, citing BCEAO 2024 data, says intra-UEMOA e-money transfers made up 7.25% of the value of Burkina Faso's mobile money transactions in 2024.
L'Oeil du Sahel, citing BCEAO 2024 data, puts intra-UEMOA transfers at 7.25% of the value of Burkina Faso's 20,139,735 million FCFA of e-money transactions in 2024.

The Africa Report says the BCEAO pilot of an interoperable instant payment system covering all eight WAEMU states, including Burkina Faso, began in early August 2024, intended to allow cross-border transactions across the zone.
